lines.english: Command therefore that the sepulchre be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He is risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first.

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᏆᎴᏗ ᎯᎠ ᏂᏚᏪᏎᎴᎢ; ᎠᏂᏯᏫᏍᎩ ᏕᏥᎧᎭ, ᎢᏤᎾ ᎾᏍᏓᏴ ᎢᎨᏨᏁᏗ ᎨᎡ ᏫᏂᏨᎦ.
lines.text: Qua-le-di hi-a ni-du-we-se-le-i; A-ni-ya-wi-s-gi de-tsi-ka-ha, i-tse-na na-s-da-yv i-ge-tsv-ne-di ge-e wi-ni-tsv-ga.
lines.english: Pilate said unto them, Ye have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as ye can.
lines.emitted_text: walehsanho hi'a tuwehselv'i aniyohski teysikhaha si itsena nahstayv ikeysvnhti kelhv oi winitsvka

lines.cherokee_syllabary: ᎰᏩᏃ ᎤᏁᏅᏎ ᎠᏍᏓᏱᏳ ᏫᏄᏅᏁᎴ ᎠᏤᎵᏍᏛᎢ, ᎤᏂᏰᎸᏔᏁ ᏅᏲᎯ, ᎠᎴ ᏚᏂᎧᏁ ᎠᏂᎦᏘᏗᏍᎩ.
lines.text: Ho-wa-no u-ne-nv-se a-s-da-yi-yu wi-nu-nv-ne-le a-tse-li-s-dv-i, u-ni-ye-lv-ta-ne nv-yo-hi, a-le du-ni-ka-ne a-ni-ga-ti-di-s-gi.
lines.english: So they went, and made the sepulchre sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.
